description: The takeover's end fixture (tools/replay/fixtures.json, `takeover-end`), on Show Down: the human ARM at slot 0 and the AI CORE at slot 1, each with its commander, which keeps its economy, and twelve light units on hold at its own end of the map, so the recording reaches GameTime 900 with both sides alive. Slots 2 and 3 are closed: a slot the scenario does not name keeps the instance's last skirmish setting, and a third seat left alive would stop the victory. Take over as 0 and type `+iwin` -- the console's IWin 0x4169D0: kill-all 0x486F10 for seat 1 and the game's won and stop flags (main+0x3923B bits 4 and 2) -- and the level must end with 0 won. Not `+kill 1`: the console's Kill disarms the objective after its kill-all (0x4164EF), so the level never ends by a victory after it. `impai-takeover-fresh` and its stock twin play it too: a takeover as 0 whose `seatai` gives ImpAI seat 1, which OTA AI played, so the takeover starts that seat fresh (tagpu_impai.c, seat_fresh), and the fork ends 600 ticks after it. Starts are fixed, so seat 0's commander stands at StartPos1 (128, 944) and seat 1's at StartPos2 (4848, 960) (maps/show down.ota, schema 0; the loader seats record i at StartPos(i+1) when the settings' +0x118 is set, 0x49790E), each about 500 px behind its own twelve guards; random starts would swap the two when rand is odd (0x4979E2..0x497A71) and stand each commander that close to the other side's guards. THE BOUND, with the guards centred on (700, 1050) and (4300, 1050): their nearest units are 3456 wu apart, and every level here ends by GameTime 1141 -- the recording at 900, the fork 600 ticks after a takeover the harness draws at or below 541 -- so a CORAK, 1.72 wu a tick, has walked at most 1961 wu by then: seat 1's guards, the only ones an AI orders (no step orders seat 0's, and nobody plays seat 0 after a takeover), cannot reach seat 0's. Commander death is off: a commander's death does not kill its side, so a lost commander cannot end the level while its twelve guards live, and the level ends only by the end scenario's clear, which leaves no unit, or by `+iwin`, which sets the stop bit itself.
